name: Kaeru Batake DE Tsukamaete: Natsu Chigira Sansen!
original_name: カエル畑DEつかまえて・夏 千木良参戦!
source: This fandisc takes places in summer. It includes after stories for each of the guys and "another stories" set in an alternative dimension.
translation: 这部Fan Disk的故事发生在夏天，收录了各位男主角的后日谈，以及以平行维度为舞台的“Another Story”。
